Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) just had their share rating of a ‘Buy’ issued by research analysts at Needham, who now has a $220 target on the $983.81B market cap company or a 9.91 % upside potential. This key information was revealed in a research report on 1 August. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Ratings Coverage
Among 33 analysts covering Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 18 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 15 Hold. Therefore 55% are positive. Apple has $235 highest and $157 lowest target. $199.84’s average target is -0.16% below currents $200.16 stock price. Apple had 65 analyst reports since February 2, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Buy” rating given on Wednesday, May 2 by Morgan Stanley. Morgan Stanley maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Tuesday, July 24 with “Overweight” rating. Rosenblatt maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Wednesday, March 7 with “Buy” rating. The firm has “Equal-Weight” rating given on Monday, April 30 by Barclays Capital. Morgan Stanley maintained it with “Overweight” rating and $214 target in Thursday, May 24 report. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Buy” rating given on Monday, March 5 by Robert W. Baird. The company was initiated on Tuesday, April 3 by Gabelli. As per Tuesday, February 13, the company rating was upgraded by Bank of America. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Hold” rating given on Monday, February 12 by Wells Fargo. KeyBanc Capital Markets downgraded the stock to “Sector Weight” rating in Friday, February 2 report.
The stock increased 5.19% or $9.87 during the last trading session, reaching $200.16. About 32.77M shares traded or 36.40% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $983.81 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 19.36 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
